zh: 一切都被表示为一个围绕 Temporal 构建的持久化线程，把每一次工具调用和模型调用表示为一个 activity。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also, as mentioned in the previous talk, we've also built a system around durable execution.

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown

speaker: Unknown
en: You know, like a worker goes out for some reason, it can resume execution from where it left off, pulling together all the state that it accumulated at that point in time, instead of starting back from like the beginning of the thread and trying to reprocess everything, which would be very inefficient and slow.
